title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 4,851–4,900 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 台灣茶藝茶道；典禮儀式

examples.en: The traditional Taiwanese tea ceremony emphasizes mindfulness, hospitality, and seasonal flower arrangements.
examples.zh: 台灣當代茶道茶藝注重靜心泡茶、以茶待客之道，並融合典雅的四季插花茶席美學。

examples.en: Graduating medical students took the Hippocratic Oath during a solemn commencement ceremony.
examples.zh: 醫學院畢業生在莊嚴隆重的畢業典禮上，齊聲莊嚴宣讀希波克拉底誓詞。

examples.en: An elaborate ribbon-cutting ceremony marked the official opening of the new light rail transit line.
examples.zh: 地方首長與貴賓出席了隆重的剪綵典禮，正式宣告全新輕軌捷運路線通車營運。

words.definition: 烏龍茶（如高山烏龍、凍頂烏龍）

examples.en: High-mountain oolong cultivated above 1,500 meters yields a floral aroma and sweet aftertaste.
examples.zh: 生長在海拔一千五百公尺高山雲霧間的高山烏龍茶，散發高雅幽蘭清香且喉韻回甘綿長。

examples.en: Dong Ding oolong from Nantou is renowned for its amber liquor and rich, roasted flavor.
examples.zh: 產自南投鹿谷的凍頂烏龍茶，以其澄澈金黃偏琥珀色茶湯與醇厚甘潤的炭焙熟果香聞名遐邇。

examples.en: Overseas tourists often purchase vacuum-sealed tins of Taiwanese oolong as premium souvenirs.
examples.zh: 許多遠道而來的國際觀光客，特地指名選購真空罐裝的頂級台灣高山烏龍茶作為餽贈親友的伴手禮。

words.definition: 小綠葉蟬（小綠葉蟬叮咬產生蜜香）

examples.en: Tiny green leafhoppers bite tea leaves, triggering the natural honey aroma of Oriental Beauty tea.
examples.zh: 微小的小綠葉蟬叮咬著涎幼嫩茶芽，促使茶樹啟動防禦機制合成出東方美人茶獨特的天然蜜香。

examples.en: Tea farmers avoid chemical pesticides so that beneficial green leafhoppers can thrive in their orchards.
examples.zh: 堅持生態友善的有機茶農嚴格杜絕化學農藥噴灑，讓小綠葉蟬能夠在茶園生態系中自然繁衍生息。

examples.en: The natural defensive reaction of plants bitten by the leafhopper produces rare sweet aromatic terpenes.
examples.zh: 茶樹嫩葉在遭到小綠葉蟬叮咬後所誘發的天然防禦代謝反應，合成了極其罕見芬芳的天然蜜香單萜類化合物。

words.definition: 春茶採收季；新芽初綻；臉紅

examples.en: Tea connoisseurs eagerly anticipate the prized spring flush harvested in early April.
examples.zh: 廣大資深茶友與老饕每年四月初，皆熱切期盼著春意盎然、滋味鮮嫩回甘的頂級「春茶」（Spring Flush）。

examples.en: Her pale cheeks flushed with warm color after drinking a steaming cup of ginger black tea.
examples.zh: 在捧著馬克杯喝下一整杯熱氣騰騰的黑糖生薑紅茶後，她原本蒼白冰冷的臉頰泛起了紅潤的氣色。

examples.en: Plentiful rainfall following a dry winter stimulated a rapid flush of emerald-green shoots across the hillside.
examples.zh: 乾旱寒冬過後豐沛及時的春雨滋養，促使整座向陽山坡茶園冒出大量生機勃勃的翠綠春梢新芽。

words.definition: 純手工採摘一心二葉的

examples.en: Expert harvesters carefully collect hand-picked tender shoots consisting of two leaves and a bud.
examples.zh: 採茶阿姨戴著斗笠穿梭茶園，以純熟手藝採集「一心二葉」頂級純手工採摘嫩芽。

examples.en: High-mountain tea requires hand-picked harvesting because steep rocky terraces make mechanical picking impossible.
examples.zh: 阿里山與梨山等高海拔茶區由於地形陡峭險峻，無法使用採茶機作業，完全仰賴採茶師傅純手工採摘。

examples.en: The festival organizers featured a hand-picked selection of indie bands from across the island.
examples.zh: 音樂祭策展主辦團隊從全島數百組報名樂團中，精挑細選出一組組最具原創魅力的獨立樂團登場獻藝。

words.definition: 茶葉日光萎凋；走水凋萎

examples.en: Solar withering under gentle morning sunshine evaporates excess leaf moisture and awakens floral scents.
examples.zh: 攤放在竹篩上的茶菁在溫和晨光下進行日光萎凋，使水分適度蒸散並喚醒茶葉深層花香。

examples.en: After solar exposure, indoor withering allows uniform moisture redistribution across the bamboo trays.
examples.zh: 結束室外日光萎凋後，隨即移至室內萎凋架靜置，使茶葉水分均勻走水並重新平衡內部含水率。

examples.en: The CEO addressed the committee's hostile questions with a single withering look of contempt.
examples.zh: 面對董事會個別成員充滿敵意的無理質疑，執行長僅投以一道極具殺傷力且充滿輕蔑的冰冷眼神回應。

words.definition: 浪茶做青；搖青工法；拋擲

examples.en: Rhythmic bamboo tray tossing gently bruises leaf edges, promoting controlled enzymatic oxidation.
examples.zh: 製茶師傅徹夜以雙手規律搖晃竹篩進行「浪茶做青」，使茶葉邊緣碰撞摩擦並展開適度酵素氧化。

examples.en: The tea master stayed up all night, alternating tossing and resting intervals based on ambient humidity.
examples.zh: 製茶大師整夜未眠守候在製茶廠，依據半夜溫濕度變化敏銳調整浪青與靜置的頻率與力道。

examples.en: He spent an anxious night tossing and turning in bed, unable to sleep before the job interview.
examples.zh: 在即將迎來關鍵求職面試的前一晚，他整個人焦慮地在床上輾轉反側、徹夜難以成眠。

words.definition: 茶葉發酵氧化度；發酵

examples.en: Partial 20% fermentation gives Baozhong tea its signature fresh lilac fragrance and golden liquor.
examples.zh: 百分之二十的輕發酵工藝，賦予文山包種茶標誌性的撲鼻優雅花香與澄澈金黃蜜綠茶湯。

examples.en: Sourdough bread development relies on slow natural wild yeast fermentation to build depth of flavor.
examples.zh: 歐式天然酵母酸種麵包的迷人口感，全憑長時間野生酵母與乳酸菌的緩慢自然低溫發酵醞釀而成。

examples.en: Taiwan's Hakka pickled mustard greens achieve rich savory umami through months of earthen crock fermentation.
examples.zh: 傳統客家庄老蘿蔔乾與福菜，經過陶甕內數月密封發酵熟成，轉化出醇厚回甘、令人回味無窮的甘醇鹹香。

words.definition: 殺青炒青（高溫高溫鍋炒滅酶）

examples.en: High-temperature panning fixation halts enzyme activity, locking in fresh botanical flavors permanently.
examples.zh: 將萎凋發酵完成的茶葉放入高溫滾筒進行炒熱「殺青」（Fixation），能及時鈍化酵素以鎖定茶香。

examples.en: Precise timing during fixation ensures that green tea retains its vibrant emerald shade without scorching.
examples.zh: 殺青炒茶時對鍋溫與時間的精準掌控至關重要，能確保碧螺春綠茶保有翠綠鮮嫩色澤且不致焦苦。

examples.en: The tech executive had an unhealthy fixation on tracking real-time daily stock ticker fluctuations.
examples.zh: 這位科技公司高層對每天即時股價走勢的漲跌震盪產生了一種近乎病態的執著與焦慮關注。

words.definition: 布球熱團揉揉捻成球；滾動

examples.en: Cloth-wrapped ball rolling shapes whole tea leaves into tight, jade-green pearl spheres.
examples.zh: 透過多道熱布球反覆包覆揉捻成球工序，將整片茶葉緊密塑形為翠綠渾圓的半球型高山茶粒。

examples.en: Repeated mechanical rolling breaks tea leaf cell walls, allowing aromatic juices to coat the surface.
examples.zh: 反覆進行的機械揉捻工藝能適度破壞茶葉細胞壁結構，讓豐富茶汁溢出並均勻附著於茶葉表面以利沖泡。

examples.en: Thunderous rolling waves crashed rhythmically against the basalt sea cliffs along the Penghu coast.
examples.zh: 澎湖海岸邊白浪滔滔，波瀾壯闊的滾滾海浪伴隨如雷巨響，規律猛烈拍打著柱狀玄武岩海蝕崖。

words.definition: 龍眼木炭焙烘焙；烘烤

examples.en: Traditional charcoal roasting over aged longan wood infuses Tieguanyin with deep smoky caramelized notes.
examples.zh: 遵循百年古法採用老龍眼木炭慢火細烘，賦予正欉鐵觀音醇厚濃郁的熟果炭香與焦糖風味。

examples.en: Specialty coffee shops take pride in small-batch roasting to accentuate single-origin citrus notes.
examples.zh: 精品獨立自家烘焙咖啡館堅持小批量精密烘豆，致力於完美凸顯單一產區咖啡豆特有的柑橘花果香。

examples.en: The holiday feast featured sweet honey-glazed ham and slow roasting root vegetables in the oven.
examples.zh: 年終感恩節豐盛晚宴上，烤箱裡端出了蜜汁慢烤金黃火腿與滋味鮮甜的慢火烘烤根莖時蔬。

words.definition: 宜興紫砂壺；手拉坏茶壺

examples.en: Unglazed purple clay teapots absorb tea oils, seasoning the interior to enhance future brews.
examples.zh: 無施釉的宜興紫砂壺能吸收茶葉精華天然茶油，長年養壺後即使用熱水沖泡亦能暗香盈室。

examples.en: She rinsed the vintage clay teapot with boiling water to warm the vessel before adding dry leaves.
examples.zh: 在投入茶乾前，她先用滾燙熱水細心溫壺淋洗這把老紫砂壺，讓陶土毛細孔充分受熱甦醒。

examples.en: The English afternoon tea set arrived on a silver tray with a floral bone china teapot and scones.
examples.zh: 英式下午茶套餐端上銀製托盤，陳列著精緻的花卉骨瓷茶壺、剛出爐的司康與濃郁凝脂奶油。

words.definition: 白瓷蓋碗（精準評茶與聞香）

examples.en: Professional tea tasters brew delicate oolongs in a thin white porcelain gaiwan for neutral tasting.
examples.zh: 專業評茶師愛用胎薄細膩的景德鎮純白瓷蓋碗，能不搶味地真實展現茶葉最純粹的花果原味。

examples.en: Tilting the gaiwan's saucer and lid allows a steady stream of amber tea to pour without splashing.
examples.zh: 巧妙運用拇指與中指扣住蓋碗邊緣並微調碗蓋縫隙，即可讓澄澈琥珀茶湯平穩傾瀉而出而不噴濺。

examples.en: Unlike clay teapots, an enamel gaiwan does not retain aromas, allowing brewers to switch teas freely.
examples.zh: 與容易吸味的紫砂陶壺不同，高溫白瓷蓋碗完全不吸附茶香殘味，讓茶師能隨心所欲輪替沖泡各類茶品。

words.definition: 茶海（公道杯；勻杯）；水罐

examples.en: Pouring hot tea into a shared pitcher ensures every guest receives an equally balanced brew.
examples.zh: 將剛泡好的滾燙茶湯先倒入公道杯茶海（Pitcher）中均勻茶色，再依序分倒各杯以示公道。

examples.en: The pitcher on the baseball mound threw an unhittable 98 mph fastball to strike out the batter.
examples.zh: 站在投手丘上的王牌先發投手，飆出一記時速高達九十八英里的凌厲直球，乾淨俐落三振打者。

examples.en: She placed an icy pitcher of fresh lemonade garnished with mint leaves on the picnic table.
examples.zh: 她在野餐草地木桌上放了一大玻璃壺插著新鮮薄荷葉的冰鎮手作檸檬水，供大家消暑解渴。

words.definition: 茶葉天然高雅花果香氣；芳香

examples.en: Inhaling the dry aroma cup releases intoxicating layers of honey, gardenia, and roasted almond.
examples.zh: 輕輕將聞香杯靠近鼻尖深呼吸，濃郁迷人的天然蜜香、梔子花香與堅果焦香層層綻放。

examples.en: The comforting aroma of freshly ground espresso filled the quiet bookstore cafe every morning.
examples.zh: 每天清晨，現磨義式濃縮咖啡豆烘焙出的溫暖香濃氣息，飄散在整間靜謐溫馨的獨立書店咖啡館中。

examples.en: Alpine cedar forests release a crisp, resinous aroma that refreshes weary hikers immediately.
examples.zh: 漫步於阿里山紅檜神木步道間，四周高聳雲杉散發出清新怡人的天然芬多精清香，令人神清氣爽。

words.definition: 精緻品茗杯；品杯

examples.en: Guests sip hot tea from small celadon porcelain teacups that cool the liquid to the ideal drinking temperature.
examples.zh: 賓客手捧溫潤青瓷品茗杯細啜慢飲，杯身小巧能讓茶湯迅速降溫至最適合入口的甘醇溫度。

examples.en: The museum's antique collection includes an imperial blue-and-white porcelain teacup from the Ming court.
examples.zh: 博物館典藏庫房中珍藏著一只明代宣德官窯青花雲龍紋壓手品茗杯，釉色濃豔青翠。

examples.en: She cradled the warm ceramic teacup with both hands while gazing out at the rain over Taipei.
examples.zh: 她雙手輕輕捧著溫暖手捏陶杯，出神地凝望著窗外大台北盆地煙雨濛濛的迷人景致。

words.definition: 實木排水茶盤；茶席托盤

examples.en: A carved solid bamboo tea tray drains excess rinse water neatly away beneath its slotted surface.
examples.zh: 雕工精細的原木竹製排水茶盤，能將溫壺洗杯的熱水順暢排入下方夾層，保持茶席乾爽整潔。

examples.en: The flight attendant walked down the airplane aisle balancing a beverage service tray with coffee and juice.
examples.zh: 空服人員踩著優雅步伐穿梭於機艙走道間，單手平穩托著放滿熱咖啡與柳橙汁的飲品服務托盤。

examples.en: Heavy wooden cafeteria trays were replaced with lightweight, recycled plastic versions.
examples.zh: 學校學生餐廳全面將原本笨重的老舊木質餐盤，汰換為輕巧耐用且符合環保標章的食品級托盤。

words.definition: 泡茶燒水生鐵壺；水壺

examples.en: A cast-iron kettle softens spring water minerals, creating velvety smooth boiling water.
examples.zh: 使用日本手工鑄造生鐵壺慢火煮水，能軟化天然山泉水中的礦物質，使水質甘冽圓潤。

examples.en: The whistle on the copper kettle announced that the water had reached a rolling boil.
examples.zh: 廚房爐火上古典銅製水壺清脆歡快的鳴笛聲響起，提醒主人壺中的開水已然沸騰翻滾。

examples.en: Modern digital electric kettles allow tea enthusiasts to dial in exact steeping temperatures to the single degree.
examples.zh: 現代高階數位溫控快煮壺，能讓講究的愛茶人士以一度為單位，隨心所欲精準設定各類茶種最佳沖泡水溫。

words.definition: 浸泡茶湯時間；浸泡

examples.en: First infusion steeping takes exactly forty-five seconds before pouring into cups.
examples.zh: 第一泡茶湯浸泡四十五秒後俐落出湯，能完美釋放茶葉初次舒展時最芬芳高雅的頭道香氣。

examples.en: Extending steeping time excessively extracts bitter tannins, overpowering the tea's natural sweetness.
examples.zh: 倘若浸泡時間過長，會將茶葉深層苦澀單寧酸過度萃取出來，進而掩蓋掉高山茶先天的甘甜喉韻。

examples.en: Traditional herbal remedies often require prolonged hot water steeping to dissolve active botanical compounds.
examples.zh: 傳統漢方草本養生茶包，通常需要以保溫杯長時間滾水悶泡，方能充分溶出根莖植物的有效活性成分。

words.definition: 沖泡次數；茶湯回沖；注入

examples.en: Premium high-mountain tea leaves unfurl slowly, yielding eight flavorful infusions without thinning out.
examples.zh: 頂級手採高山茶葉在壺中緩緩舒展綻放，即使連續回沖八道茶湯依然甘甜濃郁、韻味不減。

examples.en: The nurse set up an intravenous saline infusion to keep the dehydrated patient properly hydrated.
examples.zh: 臨床護理師熟練地為這名脫水發燒的急診病患架設生理食鹽水靜脈輸液（Infusion），以維持體液平衡。

examples.en: A massive infusion of state subsidies revitalized solar panel and semiconductor manufacturing hubs.
examples.zh: 國發基金與各項政策補貼資金的大舉注資挹注，為太陽能光電與第三代半導體產業基地注入了強大動能。

words.definition: 國家級專業評茶 (Tea Cupping)

examples.en: Blind sensory tea cupping evaluates appearance, liquor clarity, aroma profile, and leaf integrity.
examples.zh: 盲測評茶（Tea Cupping）嚴格依照國家標準，從茶乾外觀、茶湯水色、香氣層次與葉底活性逐項評分。

examples.en: Traditional Chinese medicine cupping therapy applies suction cups on sore back muscles to improve blood flow.
examples.zh: 中醫傳統拔罐療法（Cupping）透過在緊繃痠痛的背部穴位施加負壓吸力，以促進局部血液循環與活血通絡。

examples.en: Coffee buyers conduct rigorous morning cupping sessions to score microlots from Ethiopian cooperatives.
examples.zh: 國際精品生豆買家每天清晨展開極為嚴謹的杯測評比，為來自衣索比亞小農合作社的微批次咖啡豆打分。

words.definition: 東方美人麝香葡萄熟果蜜香的

examples.en: True Oriental Beauty delivers a distinct sweet muscatel grape and wild blossom flavor notes.
examples.zh: 正宗頂級新竹北埔東方美人茶，入口散發令人陶醉的天然麝香葡萄熟果香與野蜂蜜甜香。

examples.en: Darjeeling second-flush black teas are celebrated around the globe for their rare muscatel character.
examples.zh: 印度大吉嶺著名的夏摘次採紅茶，同樣因其在特定天候下孕育出的稀世珍貴麝香葡萄熟果蜜香而享譽全球。

examples.en: Wine tasters detected refreshing muscatel grape undertones in the chilled sparkling white wine.
examples.zh: 專業侍酒師在這款冰鎮白氣泡酒中，敏銳捕捉到了清新爽朗的麝香葡萄果香與白花芬芳底蘊。

words.definition: 茶湯水色；酒類；液體

examples.en: The tea liquor sparkled with crystal-clear amber brilliance in the morning light.
examples.zh: 在晨光透射下，剛出湯的頂級紅玉紅茶茶湯閃耀著清澈透亮、宛如紅寶石般的琥珀色光澤。

examples.en: Convenience stores verify national ID cards before selling hard liquor or beer to young customers.
examples.zh: 台灣各大超商門市店員在結帳各類威士忌烈酒或啤酒時，嚴格要求顧客出示身分證以確認成年身分。

examples.en: A heavy, dark mahogany liquor indicates that the Pu-erh cake has undergone decades of mature post-fermentation.
examples.zh: 呈現深邃紅濃沉穩且帶油潤光澤的深栗茶湯水色，象徵著這塊普洱老茶餅已經歷了數十載純淨陳化後發酵。

words.definition: 茶湯收斂澀感；澀味

examples.en: A well-crafted oolong balances initial pleasant astringency with instantaneous throat sweetness.
examples.zh: 一泡發酵焙火得宜的上乘烏龍茶，入口微帶清爽收斂澀感後，舌底瞬間化開生津。

examples.en: Excessive water temperatures above 95°C can highlight harsh astringency in delicate green teas.
examples.zh: 沖泡嬌嫩的低發酵綠茶若水溫超過攝氏九十五度，往往會瞬間放大並逼出過於尖銳刮舌的苦澀收斂感。

examples.en: Unripe persimmons possess extreme astringency due to soluble tannins that coat the tongue uncomfortably.
examples.zh: 尚未完全脫澀成熟的野生柿子含有高濃度水溶性單寧酸，一咬下去會帶來令人舌面緊繃麻木的強烈澀感。

words.definition: 喉韻生津回甘 (Hui Gan)；餘味

examples.en: The long-lasting sweet aftertaste lingers on the palate for minutes after swallowing.
examples.zh: 吞下溫熱茶湯後，喉頭深處源源不絕湧現出令人驚豔的生津回甘（Aftertaste），口齒留香。

examples.en: Artisanal dark chocolate has a complex bitter-sweet aftertaste with subtle hints of red berries.
examples.zh: 手工精品高純度黑巧克力在口中緩緩融化後，在舌尖留下一抹帶有野生蔓越莓果酸的迷人苦甜餘韻。

examples.en: The synthetic cough syrup left a chemical, chalky aftertaste that required drinking two glasses of water to clear.
examples.zh: 那款人工調製的兒童感冒糖漿帶有一股刺鼻的化學藥水味與粉狀粉質感餘味，讓人得狂灌兩大杯溫水才能散去。

words.definition: 茶胺酸（促進大腦放鬆專注）

examples.en: Naturally rich L-theanine amino acids promote alpha brain waves, inducing calm and focused clarity.
examples.zh: 茶葉中富含的天然「茶胺酸」（L-theanine），能激發大腦α波，營造放鬆卻高度專注的寧靜心境。

examples.en: Japanese matcha green tea contains high concentrations of theanine because tea bushes are shaded before harvest.
examples.zh: 日本宇治頂級抹茶粉之所以蘊藏極高濃度的茶胺酸，關鍵在於採收前數週茶樹經過嚴格的黑網遮光覆蓋。

examples.en: Health supplements combine theanine with natural caffeine to provide steady mental energy without coffee jitters.
examples.zh: 現代機能性保健食品將天然茶胺酸與適量咖啡因黃金配搭，能在提神醒腦的同時徹底消除心悸與焦躁感。

words.definition: 兒茶素 (EGCG 抗氧化多酚)

examples.en: Green tea polyphenols and catechins provide powerful cellular antioxidant protection against aging.
examples.zh: 未發酵三峽碧螺春綠茶中蘊含豐富的天然兒茶素（Catechin），具備極佳的抗氧化與促進新陳代謝功效。

examples.en: Clinical nutrition studies show that daily catechin intake can assist in body weight and visceral fat management.
examples.zh: 臨床營養醫學實證研究顯示，每天定量攝取天然兒茶素多酚，有助於調節生理機能並輔助體脂管理。

examples.en: High water temperatures rapidly extract catechin compounds from dry whole tea leaves during brewing.
examples.zh: 滾燙的沸水能在短時間內高效率萃取出原片茶葉中的兒茶素精華，為茶湯注入豐富天然植化素。

words.definition: 清爽甘甜冷泡茶；低溫萃取

examples.en: Steep loose oolong leaves in cold bottled water overnight for a refreshing, sweet cold brew.
examples.zh: 將高山茶葉置入冷開水瓶中放入冰箱低溫冷藏慢萃十二小時，即可享用完全不苦不澀的消暑甘甜冷泡茶。

examples.en: Cold brew coffee extracts fewer acidic oils over twenty-four hours, yielding a silky, stomach-friendly drink.
examples.zh: 低溫冷萃咖啡歷經二十四小時緩慢萃取，溶出的酸性油脂顯著降低，口感圓潤順口且較不易刺激腸胃。

examples.en: During sweltering July afternoons, local tea stands sell bottles of chilled cold brew Baozhong straight from the fridge.
examples.zh: 逢炎夏七月溽暑午後，老街茶行店門口冰桶裡擺滿了現取的冰鎮冷泡文山包種茶，沁涼解渴大受歡迎。

words.definition: 三十年傳世老茶的；老字號

examples.en: Properly aged thirty-year vintage oolong develops medicinal plum notes and soothing warmth.
examples.zh: 封存於陶甕中妥善陳化三十年的傳世極品陳年老茶，轉化出珍貴的沉香與陳香老梅乾溫潤藥香。

examples.en: She loves shopping for unique 1970s vintage dresses and leather bags in the trendy alleys of Zhongshan district.
examples.zh: 她非常熱衷於在台北中山捷運站商圈赤峰街的特色巷弄裡，尋寶挖出獨一無二的七零年代復古洋裝與老皮件。

examples.en: Winemakers in Bordeaux declared 2015 an exceptional vintage that produced robust, long-lived reds.
examples.zh: 法國波爾多各大酒莊公認二零一五年為天賜的特優年份（Vintage），釀造出單寧厚實、陳年潛力極佳的紅酒。

words.definition: 農產品產銷履歷溯源；可追溯性

examples.en: Scanning the agricultural traceability QR code verifies the tea farm’s exact slope and pesticide-free lab results.
examples.zh: 手機掃描茶葉外包裝上的產銷履歷 QR 碼，能清楚查閱茶園產地地號、茶農姓名與三百項零農藥殘留檢驗報告。

examples.en: Blockchain protocols improve supply chain traceability from raw bean harvest to overseas retail shelves.
examples.zh: 導入去中心化區塊鏈技術顯著強化了農產供應鏈的可追溯性，從高山生豆採摘到海外專櫃皆一目了然。

examples.en: Food safety legislation mandates full batch traceability across meat processing facilities.
examples.zh: 衛生福利部食安法規強制規範，全台所有大型肉品分切加工廠皆必須落實嚴格的批次生產履歷溯源。

words.definition: 產銷班優良特等獎冠軍茶；冠軍

examples.en: The champion competition oolong fetched thousands of dollars per kilogram at the spring auction.
examples.zh: 在全縣產銷班春茶評鑑競賽中勇奪「特等獎」的冠軍茶，在拍賣會上創下一台斤數十萬元的驚人身價。

examples.en: The tennis champion hoisted the championship trophy aloft as flashbulbs lit up the center court.
examples.zh: 這位衛冕成功的世界網球球王在閃光燈閃爍耀眼的中央球場中央，興奮高舉起沉甸甸的大滿貫冠軍金杯。

examples.en: Civil rights attorneys champion the protection of marginalized migrant worker rights in court.
examples.zh: 人權公益律師群長年義無反顧挺身而出，在法庭上堅定捍衛與倡導外籍弱勢移工的各項基本勞動尊嚴與法律權益。

words.definition: 茶點佐茶美食搭配美學

examples.en: Pairing roasted Tieguanyin with traditional pineapple cakes balances rich butter with brisk tea tannins.
examples.zh: 以濃香炭焙鐵觀音佐以微酸土鳳梨酥，茶湯中的天然單寧酸能巧妙解膩，形成相得益彰的茶點絕配。

examples.en: The sommelier suggested an exquisite cheese and wine pairing for the anniversary dinner course.
examples.zh: 專業侍酒師為這場結婚週年浪漫紀念晚宴的法式主菜，推薦了令人驚艷的陳年乳酪與熟成紅酒風味餐酒搭。

examples.en: Bluetooth pairing between your smartphone and the wireless noise-canceling headphones completes in seconds.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機與最新款真無線降噪耳機之間的藍牙配對（Pairing），只需輕開充電盒蓋短短數秒內即自動連線。

words.definition: 靜心正念覺察當下；正念

examples.en: Mindful tea brewing cultivates present-moment awareness through observing steam and listening to flowing water.
examples.zh: 專注靜心泡茶是一場正念修煉，透過觀察裊裊升起的茶煙與聆聽潺潺注水聲，全然安住於當下。

examples.en: Practicing daily mindfulness meditation helps software engineers manage deadline anxiety and burnout.
examples.zh: 每天清晨進行十五分鐘的正念靜心冥想，能有效協助高壓軟體工程師調節專案時限帶來的焦慮與心理倦怠。

examples.en: Eating with mindfulness encourages you to appreciate food textures rather than wolfing down meals in a rush.
examples.zh: 實踐正念飲食能引導我們慢下來細細品嚐每一口食物的原汁原味與細膩口感，而不是在匆忙狼吞虎嚥中進食。

words.definition: 奉茶熱情待客之道；殷勤好客

examples.en: In Taiwan, offering a freshly brewed cup of hot oolong is the ultimate gesture of warm hospitality.
examples.zh: 在台灣，每逢客人進門便親切奉上一杯剛沖泡好的熱騰騰高山烏龍茶，是台灣人最溫暖厚道的人情味。

examples.en: The mountain bed-and-breakfast owners touched our hearts with their generous hospitality and local breakfast.
examples.zh: 隱身於清境農場的山莊民宿主人親切純樸的待客熱忱與手作豐盛在地早餐，深深溫暖了每位旅人的心房。

examples.en: She built a rewarding corporate career across the international luxury hotel and hospitality sector.
examples.zh: 憑藉著出色的跨文化溝通能力，她在國際頂級五星級連鎖飯店與款待管理產業中開拓了輝煌的職涯格局。

words.definition: 思緒清明澄澈；清晰度

examples.en: Savoring fine tea clears the restless mind, bringing serene emotional clarity and insight.
examples.zh: 靜下心來細品一杯好茶，能洗滌平日紛擾雜亂的思緒，為內心帶來無比平靜澄澈的定力與智慧。

examples.en: The executive drafted the memo with admirable clarity, leaving no ambiguity regarding project milestones.
examples.zh: 這位營運長撰寫的專案備忘錄條理極為分明清晰，針對各階段關鍵里程碑與權責分工毫無模糊空間。

examples.en: The jeweler inspected the diamond's internal purity and optical clarity under a tenfold magnification loupe.
examples.zh: 珠寶鑑定大師手持十倍放大鏡，在專業光源下細細檢視這顆克拉鑽石內部的純淨度與透亮光學淨度。

words.definition: 天人合一茶席和諧；和諧

examples.en: A balanced tea arrangement creates aesthetic harmony between water, fire, pottery, and human hearts.
examples.zh: 一席典雅和諧的茶席佈置，在水、火、茶、器與品茗者的心靈之間營造出天人合一的和諧境界。

examples.en: Indigenous tribes historically lived in sustainable harmony with wild mountain rivers and sacred forests.
examples.zh: 原住民族祖先數千年來與腳下的大自然山林溪流敬虔共處，世世代代維繫著取之有度的永續生態和諧。

examples.en: The choir's four vocal sections blended in breathtaking four-part harmony during the solemn Christmas hymn.
examples.zh: 詩班男女四個聲部在演唱這首莊嚴神聖的耶誕頌歌時天衣無縫交融，綻放出令人屏息的四部合聲之美。

words.definition: 百年傳統製茶工藝文化資產

examples.en: Generations of tea farmers preserve centuries of intangible cultural tea making heritage.
examples.zh: 世代相傳的台灣茶農與茶師，悉心守護著歷經百年歲月淬鍊、彌足珍貴的非物質文化製茶遺產。

examples.en: Lukang's red-brick historic alleys and ancestral family shrines represent priceless national architectural heritage.
examples.zh: 彰化鹿港古色古香的紅磚曲巷與老宗祠古宅，代表著台灣極其珍貴、不可抹滅的國家級歷史建築資產。

examples.en: Proud of her Atayal tribal heritage, the artist weaved traditional diamond patterns into contemporary fashion.
examples.zh: 以自身泰雅族血統與文化根基為榮，這位青年設計師將象徵祖靈之眼的傳統菱形織紋巧妙融入當代高級時裝。

words.definition: 茶藝生活雅緻品味；優雅

examples.en: Simple bamboo utensils and handmade cups exude understated oriental elegance.
examples.zh: 簡約質樸的天然竹製茶則與手捏陶杯，在茶席間散發出低調內斂、韻味悠長的東方古典優雅美學。

examples.en: The elderly ballerina walked into the room with an upright posture and effortless natural elegance.
examples.zh: 雖然年過八旬，這位傳奇芭蕾女伶步入會場時依然身姿挺拔修長，舉手投足間流露出一種渾然天成的優雅氣質。

examples.en: The mathematician solved the complex topology theorem with breathtaking algebraic elegance.
examples.zh: 這位數學大師以極其洗鍊優美且無懈可擊的代數推導邏輯，漂亮解開了困擾學界半世紀的複雜拓撲學猜想。

words.definition: 敏銳味蕾品味鑑賞力；上顎

examples.en: Experienced tea tasters possess a refined palate capable of identifying slight harvest elevations.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的資深評茶大師擁有極其敏銳的味蕾鑑賞力，僅憑一口茶湯便能分辨出茶園海拔高度差異。

examples.en: Cleansing your palate with iced soda water between wine courses ensures unbiased taste discrimination.
examples.zh: 在不同產區美酒佳餚品嚐之間以冰氣泡水漱口清口，能恢復味蕾靈敏度以確保品評不受前道菜干擾。

examples.en: The hot melted mozzarella cheese on the freshly baked pizza burned the delicate roof of his palate.
examples.zh: 剛從高溫石窯端出來的現烤披薩上滾燙融化的莫札瑞拉起司，不小心燙傷了他嬌嫩的上顎黏膜。

words.definition: 舒緩身心緊繃壓力；撫慰

examples.en: Warm sips of roasted oolong soothe tired muscles and melt evening work stress away.
examples.zh: 睡前啜飲幾口溫潤不刺激的低咖啡因熟香焙茶，能溫柔舒緩疲憊緊繃的肌肉並融化整天的壓力。

examples.en: Mother sang a gentle lullaby to soothe the crying infant to sleep during the stormy night.
examples.zh: 在雷雨交加的狂風暴雨夜裡，母親輕聲哼唱著溫柔的搖籃曲，安撫懷中哭鬧不安的稚嫩嬰兒入眠。

examples.en: Applying pure aloe vera gel directly to sunburned shoulders helps soothe painful inflammation.
examples.zh: 在海邊戲水被強烈烈日曬傷的肩膀上塗抹一層清涼純天然蘆薈凝膠，能迅速鎮定舒緩發紅刺痛的皮膚。

words.definition: 慢啜細品茶韻；滋味

examples.en: Close your eyes to slowly savor the lingering mountain sweetness on the back of your tongue.
examples.zh: 閉上雙眼，靜下心來慢慢細品舌根深處不斷回湧的高山甘甜茶韻。

examples.en: After years of relentless sacrifice, the retiring founder took time to travel and savor life’s peaceful moments.
examples.zh: 歷經數十年商場征戰的辛勞奉獻後，榮退的創辦人終於有充裕時間攜伴環遊世界，細細品味慢活的寧靜美好。

examples.en: The authentic beef noodle soup had a savory depth and rich herbal savor that won over critics.
examples.zh: 這碗承襲三代配方的老字號紅燒牛肉麵湯頭濃醇回甘，蘊含濃郁漢方辛香料的誘人滋味，征服了各大美食家。

words.definition: 注入滾水沖泡；浸潤灌輸

examples.en: Infuse freshly boiled water across twisted leaves to release their hidden fragrance.
examples.zh: 將剛煮沸的純淨滾水沿著壺壁輕柔注入，喚醒蜷曲茶葉中深藏的千百種芬芳分子。

examples.en: The charismatic new school principal worked tirelessly to infuse fresh enthusiasm and creativity into the curriculum.
examples.zh: 這位滿懷遠大教育熱忱的新校長親力親為，努力為沉悶傳統的校園課程注入全新的活力與跨領域創新。

examples.en: The bartender infused premium London dry gin with fresh rosemary twigs and cucumber slices for forty-eight hours.
examples.zh: 調酒師將頂級倫敦琴酒與新鮮迷迭香枝條及清爽黃瓜片一同浸漬封存四十八小時，萃取出芬芳草本底蘊。

words.definition: 茶葉在熱水中緩緩舒展綻放

examples.en: Watch tight tea spheres gently unfurl into whole, emerald green leaves inside the glass pot.
examples.zh: 透過透明玻璃茶壺，靜靜欣賞緊結的茶球在熱水中如花朵般緩緩舒展綻放為完整的翠綠嫩葉。

examples.en: The crew climbed the ship's rigging to unfurl massive canvas sails as favorable trade winds picked up.
examples.zh: 當宜人的順風信風驟然揚起，甲板上的水手們俐落攀上高聳桅杆繩梯，奮力展開巨大的帆布風帆啟航。

examples.en: A breathtaking mountain panorama unfurled before our eyes as the morning mist lifted from the peak.
examples.zh: 當清晨高山上的濃重雲霧隨風漸漸散去，一幅壯麗非凡的中央山脈連峰全景在我們眼前徐徐展開。

words.definition: 茶湯口感溫潤醇厚圓融的

examples.en: Years of clean cellar storage made the aged tea exceptionally mellow and smooth on the throat.
examples.zh: 歷經多年無異味通風乾燥儲存，這款陳年老烏龍茶湯口感變得格外溫潤醇厚、絲滑順喉。

examples.en: As he matured into his fifties, his youthful fiery temper mellowed into gentle, patient wisdom.
examples.zh: 隨著年歲邁入沉穩知天命的五十歲，他早年剛烈急躁的火爆脾氣逐漸轉化為慈眉善目的謙和與包容智慧。

examples.en: Mellow acoustic guitar melodies played softly in the background while diners enjoyed dinner.
examples.zh: 溫暖醇厚的原聲木吉他旋律在餐廳背景中如流水般輕柔流淌，營造出無比放鬆愜意的用餐氛圍。

words.definition: 春茶鮮爽清新明亮的；脆的

examples.en: Spring Bi Luo Chun delivers a crisp, lively morning freshness bursting with green energy.
examples.zh: 早春採摘的三峽碧螺春帶有一股鮮爽明亮、生氣蓬勃的草木鮮綠氣息，為早晨注入滿滿活力。

examples.en: We took an early morning walk through the tea orchard, breathing in the crisp mountain air.
examples.zh: 清晨一大早我們漫步在雲霧飄渺的茶園步道間，深深呼吸著略帶寒意卻極致純淨的高山清新冷空氣。

examples.en: The chef served golden, crisp Taiwanese fried chicken cutlets dusted with fragrant white pepper and basil.
examples.zh: 主廚端上剛起鍋、炸至金黃酥脆的經典台式大雞排，撒上滿滿香濃白胡椒鹽與酥炸九層塔，令人食指大動。

words.definition: 遠離塵囂茶境寧靜；平靜

examples.en: Stepping into the mountain tea house wraps guests in a peaceful aura of deep tranquility.
examples.zh: 走入隱身於山林雲霧間的雅緻茶空間，滿室茶香為身心披上一層遠離塵囂、無比深沉的靜謐寧靜。

examples.en: Sun Moon Lake at dawn exudes a mirror-like tranquility that washes away urban stress.
examples.zh: 破曉時分的日月潭湖面宛如一面澄澈明鏡，波瀾不驚的祥和靜謐能洗淨現代都會人的一切疲憊焦慮。

examples.en: The monk's serene eyes reflected an unshakeable inner tranquility forged through decades of silent meditation.
examples.zh: 老和尚平靜深邃的眼神中，映照出一種歷經數十年閉關打坐參禪方能修得的、堅不可摧的內在寧靜。

words.definition: 以茶會友雅集聚會；聚會

examples.en: Friends host seasonal tea gatherings to taste newly arrived winter flushes and share poetry.
examples.zh: 三五好友定期舉辦四季茶席雅集聚會，一同開箱品評剛烘好的頭等冬茶並吟詩交流心得。

examples.en: The family hosted a festive Mid-Autumn barbecue gathering on the spacious rooftop terrace.
examples.zh: 逢中秋月圓佳節，全家親友在寬敞的頂樓露天大露台張羅了一場熱鬧溫馨的炭火烤肉團圓聚會。

examples.en: A massive gathering of environmental activists staged a peaceful sit-in outside the legislative building.
examples.zh: 上千名熱心關切土地正義與環境永續的民間倡議志工，在立法院門口聚集舉行了一場理性平和的靜坐請願。

words.definition: 茶花；盛開的花朵；開花

examples.en: White tea blossoms blooming among dark evergreen bushes indicate healthy ecological soil.
examples.zh: 綻放在深綠茶樹叢間的素雅白色茶花，是茶園未施化學除草劑、土壤生態健康盎然的天然象徵。

examples.en: Thousands of tourists flock to Yangmingshan in February to admire cherry blossoms in full bloom.
examples.zh: 每逢二月春暖花開時節，數以萬計的踏青遊客湧向陽明山花季，爭相搶睹漫山遍野盛開的粉紅櫻花。

examples.en: Her natural leadership skills blossomed under the supportive mentorship of the department head.
examples.zh: 在部門主管耐心包容與亦師亦友的提攜指導下，她卓越的天生領導才能與溝通潛力獲得了璀璨綻放。

words.definition: 細心栽種茶樹；涵養品味

examples.en: Organic tea growers cultivate heirloom bushes using natural compost and mountain spring irrigation.
examples.zh: 堅持友善大地的有機茶農以天然堆肥與甘冽山泉水悉心灌溉茶樹，在天地滋養下涵育頂級茶菁。

examples.en: Reading classic literature from around the world helps cultivate critical thinking and emotional depth.
examples.zh: 廣泛閱讀世界古典文學與哲學經典名作，有助於涵養青年的獨立批判性思維與深厚的人文同理心。

examples.en: Forward-thinking companies actively cultivate collaborative working cultures where constructive dissent is welcomed.
examples.zh: 具備前瞻遠見的跨國企業主動培育包容開放的協作文化，由衷鼓勵員工提出多元具建設性的不同聲音。

words.definition: 感恩天地山林滋養的謝意

examples.en: Holding a warm cup of tea fills our hearts with quiet gratitude for nature's bountiful gifts.
examples.zh: 雙手捧著這杯溫暖甘醇的茶湯，內心由衷升起對大自然陽光、雨露與茶師辛勤付出的深深感恩。

examples.en: He wrote a heartfelt letter of gratitude to the doctors and nurses who cared for his ailing father.
examples.zh: 他親筆寫下一封字字句句滿懷真摯謝意的感謝信，由衷致敬日夜悉心照料病危老父親的醫護團隊。

examples.en: Starting every morning by listing three things you are thankful for cultivates long-term happiness and emotional gratitude.
examples.zh: 養成每天清晨在手帳寫下三件值得感恩之事的晨間好習慣，能讓內心常保富足感恩，涵養長久的幸福感。
